method: Every final PNG was opened with view_image. This manual pixel inspection complements public DOM/native control observations and actual binary HTTP response fingerprints.
scope: Actual compiled application served locally with production CSP and QA hook absent. Initial isolated deck/RNG fixtures are registered before start; subsequent actions use public controls and observations use public DOM only. Native free duel is not a certification of all TCG Advanced legality or full rules/artwork 1:1.
